retrieval_skill.name: incident_regime_evidence
retrieval_skill.description: Retrieve evidence that connects a physical incident to its onset, quantified operational impact, clearance point, and post-clearance regime behavior.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasting a time series that may be temporarily altered by a documented physical disruption.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search for the affected system, incident type, relevant temporal window, measured deviation from baseline, clearance status, and historical post-clearance recovery patterns; separate future-driver evidence from regime evidence.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept claims only when sources explicitly identify the physical mechanism and temporal window; require quantified impact and clearance claims to be directly supported, and verify recovery behavior with historical evidence rather than assuming it.
